title: Registry Casework Requester
description: Place this object in configuration.casework. The Requester credential remains in OpenFn configuration.

baseUrl.description: Registry Casework deployment URL, including any reverse-proxy prefix.

token.description: Requester bearer token without the Bearer prefix.

profile.description: Configured Casework Requester profile bound to this credential.

trustedRootCertificates.description: PEM trust roots for the Registry Casework HTTPS connection.
